data.one_liner: Dart Result Monad for handling success/failure without exceptions
data.what_it_does: Provides a Result type with Ok and Error variants to represent successful or failed operations. It offers functional helpers for chaining, mapping, and matching results without throwing exceptions.
use_when: Handling operations that may fail and you want to avoid try/catch
When you need explicit success/failure propagation
avoid_when: When you prefer traditional exception handling
When performance overhead of Result objects matters
When working with APIs that already use exceptions
weaknesses: May be overkill for small projects
